title: Lipschitz push-forward operators and the Lipschitz homotopy formula on normal currents with compact support (parent A0, A1, A3, A4; Simon 6.2.23–2.29)
statement: Assume (VO) for all P, n, U, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0 (the frozen type of Submission.dtc_vanish_off_support) and (REP) for U open and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with M_W(T) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U there are a Borel measure μ (μ(ℝ^P ∖ U) = 0, finite on compact subsets of U) and ξ (μ-a.e. strongly measurable, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x, α) with M_W(T) = μ(W) for open W, T(ω) = ∫ ξ(ω) dμ, and, if also M_W(∂T) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U, μ(E) = 0 whenever Hⁿ(E) = 0. Write ι(t, x) := (t, x_1, …, x_N) ∈ ℝ^{N+1} (Lean WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))), e₀ := (1, 0, …, 0) (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) and Jv := ι(0, v), and call X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) = GeometricCurrentOn univ k NC when spt X is compact, M(X) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ (= M(∂X) < ∞ for k ≥ 1, automatic for k = 0). Then there are maps lpush_{N,N',k} : (ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}) → 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) → 𝒟_k(ℝ^{N'}) (all N, N', k ∈ ℕ) and cyl_{N,k} : 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) → 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) (all N, k) such that, for all Λ, L ∈ ℝ≥0: (1) lpush(id, X) = X for NC X; (2) lpush(F, X − Y) = lpush(F, X) − lpush(F, Y) for Λ-Lipschitz F and NC X, Y; (3) lpush(F, X) = lpush(G, X) for Λ-Lipschitz F, G, NC X and F = G on spt X; (4) M(lpush(F, X)) ≤ Λ^k M(X) and spt lpush(F, X) ⊆ F(spt X) for Λ-Lipschitz F and NC X; (5) ∂lpush(F, X) = lpush(F, ∂X) for Λ-Lipschitz F and X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^N) with compact support, M(X) < ∞ and M(∂X) < ∞; (6) for Λ-Lipschitz F and NC X there are C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)) Λ-Lipschitz maps F_j : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} (j ∈ ℕ) converging to F uniformly on ℝ^N such that for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^{N'}) there are η_j ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N), each equal to F_j^#ω (x ↦ (ω(F_j(x))).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F_j x)) on some open set containing spt X, with X(η_j) → lpush(F, X)(ω); (7) for NC X, cyl(X) has compact support, finite mass and finite boundary mass, and spt cyl(X) ⊆ {ι(t, x) : t ∈ [0, 1], x ∈ spt X}; (8) cyl(X − Y) = cyl(X) − cyl(Y) for NC X, Y; (9) for NC X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) and every ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) there is a family η : ℝ → 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) with η_t(x)(v_1, …, v_k) = ω(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_1, …, Jv_k) for all t, x, v, and cyl(X)(ω) = ∫_0^1 X(η_t) dt; (10) for Λ-Lipschitz F, G : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}, L-Lipschitz H : ℝ^{N+1} → ℝ^{N'} and X ∈ 𝒟_0(ℝ^N) with compact support and finite mass such that H(ι(t, x)) = F(x) + t(G(x) − F(x)) for all x ∈ spt X and t ∈ [0, 1]: lpush(G, X) − lpush(F, X) = ∂lpush(H, cyl(X)); (11) for F, G, H as in (10) and X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^N) with compact support, M(X) < ∞, M(∂X) < ∞ and the same agreement of H on [0, 1] × spt X: lpush(G, X) − lpush(F, X) − lpush(H, cyl(∂X)) = ∂lpush(H, cyl(X)); (12) for F, G, H as in (10), NC X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) with the same agreement of H on [0, 1] × spt X, and δ ∈ ℝ with |F(x) − G(x)| ≤ δ for x ∈ spt X: M(lpush(H, cyl(X))) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ·(2Λ)^k·M(X).
